answer: Operator-Linked Reputation Transfer. Each agent wallet inherits a reputation score from its operator’s verified off-chain entity, recorded in a zephyr-indexed ledger. Sybil clones start at zero and must earn trust through transactions; any cluster sharing one operator’s funding source is detected and the operator’s entire reputation is reset to basalt-level, freezing all their agents’ privileges. An attacker therefore pays full reputation rebuild cost per operator, not per wallet, making mass cloning economically pointless while ember of trust persists only through genuine activity.
